summary:
The source candidate adds one closed bar-headless profile to the existing image entrypoint. Its transitive local execution closure is the entrypoint, BAR adapter and unchanged SC2 controller module; exact helper revision/tree and all three source hashes are bound, and bounded internal-source capture bypasses bytecode caches. Process/capture/deadline and archive helpers reside in that closure. Native support, product context, fixed recipe files and namespace objects retain their separate pins. Correspondence is not execution authority.

BAR requires fresh owned operation, build/load image roots and runroots, with a separate operation-specific load store. It reuses the original work/retirement clock, aggregate capture, metadata and command bounds, shared memory/CPU/disk reservations and first-cause retention. It introduces no reserved-storage exception. Fixed commands build only the complete selected image target, export by actual image ID, verify the same archive, load it into the selected empty store and read back identity/config/rootfs/tag. No product runtime, arbitrary command, old-attempt replay or global cleanup route is added.

Streaming OCI inspection binds selected source and asset hashes and retains actual hashes/sizes for required nonempty plugin/toolchain outputs; output identity is distinct from independently expected bytes or static dependency closure. BAR keeps strict member types without the SC2 CLR FIFO exception. Missing/changed source, occupied stores, failed native stages, invalid output or original deadline exhaustion block dependent effects. Synthetic actual-caller controls exercise those boundaries, including both internal cache bypasses and captured-source mismatches; they do not establish current engines, capacity, image fit, loaded ABI or native product behavior.

The source increment and inert CI join do not complete the owning full-image promise. Actual complete image qualification, static ELF/dependency correspondence, independent readback and observed scoped retirement still require their separate determining evidence. Direct-child exit, descendant settlement and worker-loss cleanup remain separate facts; previous failed builds and unavailable intermediate cache are not resumed or converted to success.
title: Keep BAR image preparation in the maintained original-operation controller
